Jules (PM): quick sync: planning a "lite" design-partner run for the new private deploy flow. goal: fast signal, low ops burden.
Rhea (Design): love lite. propose 12 partners, 2-week engagement each, focused tasks only.
Cam (Eng): agree. suggest dedicated feature flag + one fallback variant. keep canary at 3 partners first 48h.
Noah (Research): signal plan: 4 deterministic tasks + 2 exploratory sessions. capture automated eval + short form survey.
Jules (PM): acceptance criteria for launch: <10% regression on eval bundle, no P1 incidents, average partner NPS >=7. if breach, hold ramp and triage.
Rhea (Design): I'll draft partner brief + consent blurb. include screenshot examples and minimal setup steps.
Cam (Eng): infra note: reserve 3 concurrent slots for canary, 8 for full run. provide runbook snippet for rollback.
OpsBot: Canary policy configured: 25% -> 100% with hold triggers wired to eval-delta and error-rate.
Noah (Research): I'll prepare the eval bundle and quick scoring script. aim to ship by Thu.
Jules (PM): ok owners: Rhea = comms, Cam = infra/runbook, Noah = evals, Jules = invites. kickoff Fri 10am PT.
Rhea (Design): flagged: include a short troubleshooting FAQ.
Cam (Eng): noted. will post runbook snippet in #dp-onboarding.
Jules (PM): thanks everyone. short and reusable playbook is the outcome.
OpsBot: Event created: "Lite DP: private-deploy flow kickoff" Fri 10:00 PT.
